extName.message: CartIQ — Smart Cart Assistant for AliExpress

extDescription.message: Scans your AliExpress cart and open tabs, finds duplicates and cheaper alternatives, and rates seller trust with AI.

popup_notOnCart.message: Open your AliExpress cart or a product page to get started.

popup_emptyCart.message: Your cart looks empty — nothing to compare yet.

popup_productScanFailed.message: Couldn't read this product's details. Try reloading the page, then reopen this popup.

popup_noPriceDetected.message: Couldn't detect a price for this product, so a search wouldn't be reliable.

popup_searchFailed.message: The search didn't finish in time. Try again in a moment.

popup_timeout.message: The AI request took too long and was cancelled. Try again.

popup_searchingAlternatives.message: Searching AliExpress for a better price...

popup_needsApiKey.message: Add your Claude API key in Settings to enable AI analysis.

popup_error.message: Something went wrong. Try scanning again.

options_apiKeyHelp.message: Your key is stored only on this device (chrome.storage.local) and is sent only to api.anthropic.com to analyze your cart. CartIQ never sends your key or cart data anywhere else.

options_similarityHelp.message: Lower = only flags near-identical titles. Higher = flags more loosely related items too.

options_watchEnable.message: Notify me about price drops in open cart tabs

options_watchHelp.message: Only checks while an AliExpress cart tab is actually open in your browser — CartIQ cannot check your cart in the background.

compare_empty.message: No open AliExpress product tabs found. Open a few product pages and click Refresh.

compare_noCheaperFound.message: No cheaper alternative found on AliExpress search.
